title: offer choices not only text
rule: When possible, offer choices (picker, menu, or other selection) instead of requiring text entry.
pass_when: Where a known choice set exists, user picks (picker/menu/selection) instead of typing.
fail_when: Known choice set is text-entry only.
overview: Offer picker or menu choices instead of text entry when a set is known.
apply_when: Known choice sets where picking is possible instead of typing.
not_when: Open answers with no predefined choice set.
agent_hint: Prefer picker/menu/selection over text when the choice set is known.
description: When possible, offer choices — picker, menu, or other selection — instead of requiring text entry. Pass where a known choice set exists and the user picks rather than types; fail when that known set is text-entry only. Selection reduces typos and format errors for closed option spaces without inventing choices where none already exist.
